title: Google Cloud and Mysten Labs Launch AI Agent Evidence Tool

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The Sui network and Walrus Protocol will now host the record infrastructure for a new system designed to audit autonomous software behavior. Called the Verifiable Agent Arbiter (VAA), the evidence layer is a collaboration between Google Cloud and Mysten Labs that enables corporations to prove their AI agents operated within specified authority limits.

The system addresses the need for corporate accountability and enterprise compliance as autonomous agents increasingly perform tasks on behalf of businesses. By anchoring these proofs to a blockchain, the partners aim to create trustworthy, permanent records that confirm whether an agent exceeded its designated mandates during operation.
